subject: Fix the build on less common platforms in zmalloc.c (#1922)
reason: The change only relocates the declaration of the used_memory_thread pointer into the #if/#else in zmalloc.c so that on non-x86/ARM/PowerPC platforms it is declared _Atomic size_t* to match the _Atomic array, fixing a compile error there. On the platforms the fuzzer runs (linux x86_64/arm) the preprocessed source is identical to the parent, so there is no runtime behaviour change to exercise; it is purely a build fix.
